limitations: Attention uses two native synthetic modules with reused weights/activations/KV and explicit producer ownership across 78 calls; it does not reproduce 78 independent layer weight/cache working sets.
Attention-only capture lacks intervening MLP/communication queue occupancy. Matching 100 segments/99 breaks does not prove full-model attention latency.
Communication block measurement reuses mutable state; normalization by 100 is the prospectively reviewed per-boundary approximation, not full-model resident calibration.
Ideal routed/shared branch max and empirical norm/add costs remain approximations; the synthetic routed distribution is not the full forward token routing.
Seven exact-context comparison against full native forward is a bounded acceptance test, not validation of TTFT, scheduler, unseen contexts, decode, other images or the whole Vera-Rubin platform.

evidence.container_validation: Exact8 named .npy members only, no extras/duplicates/directories, object arrays or pickle; expected fixed dtype/shape/C-order, exact uncompressed member sizes/hashes and whole NPZ digest/size. Use allow_pickle=False. Reject scalar/broadcast/ragged/range/shape/dtype/mask/slot/fixture/hash inconsistencies. Bounded decompression is required; compressed size alone is not a bound.
evidence.exact_semantics: Output mismatch counts compare raw16-bit BF16 representations elementwise, including signed zeros and NaN payloads. Each passed row equals reference_finite AND candidate_finite AND reference_nonzero AND candidate_nonzero AND(bit_mismatches==0). Nonzero means at least one numerical nonzero value in the row; +/-0 both count as zero. Finite flags must be true even when nonfinite bit patterns match. Index row equality is exactly(mismatched_elements==0). All source tensors have exact expected source dtypes/shape and C-order raw byte hash encoding; metadata must not call BF16 raw hashes float32 hashes. Counts retain every row, including failing ones; no L2/cosine/argmax reduction is claimed.

failure_witnesses.counts: Persist every failing row/element total per comparison and campaign, including finite/nonzero failures with zero mismatches; explicit witness retained/total counts and truncation flags even after global witness limit. All per-row exact reductions remain complete. Failed/unfinished matrices never qualify.
failure_witnesses.order: Declared context order, declared arm order, fixture order, eager-reference then repeatability, slot/producer order, row order.
failure_witnesses.output_dtype_shape: uint16[retained_output_rows,2,6144], explicitly raw BF16 bits; preserves signed zero and nonfinite payloads for both complete rows

test_requirements: CPU/GPU comparator semantic negatives: one changed BF16 element/row, signed-zero bit change in an otherwise nonzero row, NaN/Inf including identical nonfinite bit patterns, all-zero rows, exact index mismatch and repeatability mutation. Every case rejects without tolerance fallback.

Round-trip all bool/uint16 row reductions through NPZ exactly and recompute the stronger gate; mutations for dtype/range/shape/extra/missing/duplicate member, digest, fixture/slot/group dependency changes.
Observer negative tests for stale producer pointer despite identical values, overlapping historical output/index spans and missing owners; prove wrappers/checks are removed before timing.
CPU work/count/byte budgets, bounded NPZ decompression, witness fixed order/global limits and archive cap checks; no fabricated GPU performance evidence.

communication_config.fixture_description: Contiguous BF16 [tokens,6144], two deterministic per-rank CUDA-generator random fixtures; residual uses a common rank-independent seed, hidden uses distinct rank seeds. Norm weights come from the exact checkpoint tensor named for each role; no model forward or dummy model is constructed.

measurement.warmup_policy: Five untimed calls immediately before each timing window; graph-capture warmup and numerical audits are also untimed.

communication_config.normalization_scope: A following-MLP boundary is the preceding TP reduction plus next-layer input norm, even where long-token serving performs the reduction before the next layer. Excludes first-layer norm, final-model norm, last-layer plain all-reduce, routed/shared result addition and all surrounding computation.
communication_config.qualification: Numerical and dispatch gates qualify only this isolated measurement. They do not qualify prefill/decode logits or the AISimulate 15 percent forward-time target.
communication_config.reference: Role-specific native unfused all-reduce followed by native RMSNorm(x,residual), always outside CUDA-graph capture. Graph output and residual are also compared with the native eager selected boundary.
communication_config.scope: Diagnostic native TP4 communication plus residual/RMSNorm timing protocol comparison; synthetic activations and real representative norm weights. The block arm measures repeated native buffer bindings, not a model forward. No public performance rows or forward-accuracy qualification.
communication_config.sequence_reference: Block graph final output/residual for each of five independent buffer pairs is compared with native selected eager applying the same twenty updates to that pair without input restoration between updates. Both fixtures, two repetitions and every post-window final result retain complete per-row evidence. Single-call control preserves selected-eager and unfused-reference gates.
communication_config.timing_boundary: Graph-only diagnostic: fresh one-call/one-replay control and fixed five-call/twenty-replay block. Restore independent input/residual pairs, synchronize and Gloo-barrier before events. No restore/copy/audit/counter inside events. Max aligned four-rank block duration is divided by declared native calls per sample; all thirty samples are retained.
